# dsh-plugin-lab plugin index
English | 中文

One URL that puts every plugin from dsh-plugin-lab into DSH's
Discover tab: name, description, icon
and an installable version, for each plugin.
## How to add it to DSH

1. In **Plugins**, open **Custom plugin indexes**, and turn it on.
2. Open **Plugins → Discover**, c
hoose **Add index source**, and paste this URL:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
3. The plugins appear. Pick one and install it.
## Which plugins it lists

Every plugin in github.com/dsh-plugin-lab. The list is discovered
from the organization's public rep

ositories, so it follows what that organization publishes; nothing
is listed by hand here.
Each entry lists every published version, prereleases included. Versions its package marks deprecate

d
on npm are left out — open one and pick the version you want.
## How often it updates
The index rebuilds itself: several times a day, and right after any change that affects what it list

py you are
reading was built.
